description: List ViralHunt content templates (layouts you fill and render yourself), favourites first, each with what it suits. Lean by design (no html/css), so use viralhunt_get_template for the one you'll actually render. Available on the Free plan and spends no daily query: with viralhunt_get_template preview true it is how a free user sees a viral post in their niche as their own post.

assigned.description: true = only the templates assigned to project_id.

favorites.description: true = only the templates the brand starred. Favourites come first in every list: prefer them when several fit.

media_type.description: Filter by what it renders to.

network.description: Only templates suited to this network.

per_page.description: Page size (default 20). The answer's meta says total and has_more.

project_id.description: With assigned=true, the project whose allowed templates you want.

scope.description: org = only the organization's own templates (they also come first in every list), global = only the library.

name: viralhunt_list_templates
